summary: Allocates a texture buffer through BufferLockAllocate (00540F00), guarded by an already-allocated flag. Reads flags at this[8], sets bit 0x100 to mark allocation done, indexes a format-descriptor array through this[20] using the a2 slot shifted left 6, selects a 96-byte or 32-byte entry size from flag bit 0x80, and stores the returned handle back into the descriptor at offset +32. Uses global dword_8B78A0 (0x008B78A0) as the buffer-lock manager pointer. Called by sub_558A30, sub_558B30, PixelAttributeWriteToTexture, PixelWriteToTextureBuffer, and sub_558E70.

local_names.this[8]: allocation flag word (bit 0x100 set once allocation done; bit 0x80 selects entry size)
local_names.this[11]: element count used in total-size calculation (96-byte path)
local_names.a2: descriptor slot index (shifted left 6 to reach slot record)
local_names.v5: a2 << 6 slot offset into the descriptor table
local_names.dword_8B78A0: buffer-lock manager instance passed to BufferLockAllocate

operations.description: Read this[8]; if bit 0x100 is already set the allocation is skipped and the existing result is returned
Set the allocation-done bit: v4 = result | 0x100 and write it back to this[8]
Compute the slot offset v5 = a2 << 6 into the descriptor table this[20]
Store the returned allocation handle into the descriptor: *(this[20] + v5 + 32) = result
Return the allocation result handle (or the previously stored flags value on the guarded path)
Invoked by sub_558A30, sub_558B30, PixelAttributeWriteToTexture, PixelWriteToTextureBuffer, and sub_558E70 to lazily allocate a texture buffer on first use
